text: Lowkey Cooking
Settlement Glow-Up
The OG Founders
From one sad hut to a whole city, fr. The origin story is gonna skip the hut, no cap.
Big Brain Era
The Big Brains
Your scholars learned enough to be unbearable at dinner. Every party is a lecture now, no cap.
Build Different Arc
The Blueprint Crew
Monuments go up so fast your rivals are still on slide one of being impressed. Bussin construction.
Military Hype Arc
The Main Threat
Your neighbors stopped sending letters and started sending apology gift baskets. Respect, earned.
Bag Chase Arc
The Hustle Crew
All roads lead to your market, and every road pays a little toll. Certified hustle, fr.
Ancient Era Speedrun
The Old Heads
You speedran five ages and only set fire to most of them. Chaotic, but make it a W.
Rising Star Era
Built Different
Full Main Character
GOAT Status
Ascended, No Cap
Roof Goals Unlocked
Drop your first hut, bestie.
A roof and four walls, and the whole civ arc is officially in motion, fr.
Village Vibe Check
Hit a population of 250, no cap.
Two hundred and fifty souls, and one of them already wants a committee. Power trip energy, fr.
Town Is Poppin
Get your population to 1,500, bestie.
A real town now, with a market, a tavern, and at least one beef that's going nowhere. Sus and iconic.
City Level Up
Let's gooo, hit a population of 5,000.
Five thousand people, and the traffic jam just spawned out of thin air. Absolutely cooked, no cap.
Big City Rizz
Crack a population of 15,000 and watch the rizz kick in.
Fifteen thousand people, and you can't name a single one. Sis, that's not a city, that's a group chat.
Mega City Era
Pull a population of 250,000, it's giving empire.
A quarter of a million people, and the census crew has filed for early retirement. Understood the assignment.
Sprawl Out Loud
Keep spreading until the population hits 50,000, fr.
The city has no edges anymore, it's just vibing and being the city. Unbothered, honestly.
Global Hub Rizz
Max out a population of 1,000,000, world domination energy.
A million people, and the planet has formally filed a complaint about the crowd. Certified menace.
Stuff Stash Era
Cook up your first Stash, it's time to organize.
A place for your stuff so it stops wandering off to other people's houses. Real organization energy.
Hoard Network
Go full hoarder with 5 Storage Pits.
Ten pits of premium hoarded surplus, and the hoarding instinct finally got its W. Iconic.
Snack Keeper
Raise 5 Granaries, the snack game is strong.
Twenty-five granaries, and the mice are taking it as a personal invite. Rude, but relatable.
Rock Star Mason
Stack 22 Stone Pits, the rock game is bussin.
Thirty pits of honest stone, and the masons are done vibing with mud. Real craft era, fr.
Timber Squad
Put up 25 Wood Camps and let the log crew cook.
Twenty-five camps, and the forest is owed a sincere apology. The trees are shook, no cap.
Early Bird Builder
Rack up 250 structures total, the grind is real.
Two hundred and fifty buildings, and you stopped naming them. Now it's just numbers, we're in our data era.
Rock and Ore Crew
Dig 22 Stone Pits and 10 Iron Mines, rock and roll.
Stone and iron in industrial amounts, and the hills are visibly catching anxiety. Unhinged energy, fr.
Forge Gremlin
Fire up 15 Smithies, we're forging legends.
Fifteen forges roaring at once, and the whole valley smells like ambition. Hot metal, hotter vibes.
Veteran Builder Era
Clock 500 structures total, keep the streak alive.
Five hundred buildings, and you could get lost in your own civ. Honestly you already do, every day.
Builder GOAT
Crank out 1,000 structures total, certified grinder.
A thousand structures. Future archaeologists are gonna assume you were flexing, and honestly, valid.
Wonder Maker Era
Finish your first wonder, it's giving legacy.
You built a Wonder and the neighbors are impressed. One is drafting a very strongly worded letter, sis.
Grand Blueprint Boss
Log 1,365 structures total, the blueprint's getting spicy.
Two thousand buildings, and the mapmakers unionized and clocked out. Iconic, but they're owed a raise.
Wonder Drip Era
Erect 8 wonders and collect the clout, bestie.
Eight Wonders, and rival empire tourists now visit just to feel inadequate. Respectfully, ouch.
Wonder Mogul
Stack 15 wonders, the flex is real.
Fifteen Wonders, and at this point it's just a very expensive hobby. Financially irresponsible, iconic.
Brain Food Hunter
Bank 10,000 research, we're learning fast.
Ten thousand units of knowledge, and the dawning realization that you still know nothing. Humbling, but the vibe is immaculate.
First Brain Drop
Crack open your first tech, nerdy era.
Your first real invention. Someone will glow it up tomorrow and take all the credit, sigh.
Tech Trailblazer
Chew through 22 techs, keep the brain on the grind.
Breakthrough after breakthrough, and the wheel was in there somewhere. Bussin lineup, honestly.
Nerd Paradise
Staff 50 scholars and build 3 Libraries, big brain zone unlocked.
Three libraries, fifty scholars, and a full-on beef about quiet hours. Peak drama, zero silence.
Deep Thought Era
Think through 46 techs and stay in the think tank.
Tech on tech on tech, and your scholars now end every sentence with 'well, actually.' Insufferable, fr.
Thinker Squad
Load up 64 techs, the group chat is getting deep.
Enough tech to fill a salon, and the philosophers now argue on purpose. Peak discourse, we love to see it.
Renaissance Rizz
Hoard 83 techs and feel the glow-up.
So many techs that the answer to everything now needs a sequel. Plot twist era, no cap.
Great Library Drop
Finish the Great Library, the ultimate brain dump.
Great Library: all the wisdom of the age and overdue fines to match. Big brain, bad return policy.
Tech Lord Era
Clear 114 techs and never log off.
Techs mastered by the shelf. You understand the universe well enough to be properly worried, and that's the vibe check.
Tech Tree Cleared
Every tech researched, and the tree is bald. You did this, bestie, don't let it go to your head.
Soldier Starter Pack
Train 5 soldiers, the squad is small but mighty.
Five soldiers. Technically an army if you squint and don't ask them to march in step. Mid, but make it military.
Chaos Machine
Recruit 250 soldiers and bring the drip.
Two hundred and fifty soldiers, and the neighbors suddenly got very polite. Diplomacy by vibes.
Standing Squad
Train 100 soldiers and drop 10 Barracks, the squad needs a crib.
An army that actually stands where you tell it to. Discipline is a whole miracle, bestie.
Iron Hype Squad
Field 500 soldiers and drop 10 Barracks, the squad is unhinged.
Five hundred soldiers in iron, and the blacksmiths are begging for one week off. Stop the grind, king.
Fortress Lore Era
Raise 13 Castle Keeps and go full medieval.
Twenty castle keeps, and your kingdom is less a country now, more a very pointed suggestion. Respectfully, unhinged.
Army Superpower Era
Marshal 2,000 soldiers, the military rizz is unmatched.
Two thousand troops, and diplomacy is now just other people agreeing with you, real quick. Power move, no thoughts.
First Hustle Stop
Set up your first Market, the hustle begins.
A market, so now your people can haggle over prices instead of just yoinking stuff. Civilized, peak.
Stall Town Era
Open 8 Markets, the swap game is bussin.
Eight markets and a guild with very strong opinions about everybody else's business. Unbothered, but nosy.
Caravan Connect
Plant 5 Trading Posts and get the route running.
Five trading posts, and the caravans have a route, a schedule, and a messy rivalry. Plot, drama, main character energy.
Trade Royalty
Stack 12 Trading Posts and 4 Merchant Quarters, royal drip required.
Merchant princes now. Nicer hats than you, and they know it, bestie.
Trade Empire Era
Run 20 Trading Posts and Merchant Quarters in any mix, you pick the vibe.
Trade empire, and somewhere a coin is changing hands in your name right now. And now. And now.
Sea Lord Era
Drop 5 Harbors, 5 Ports and 2 Seaports, the sea is your playground.
Seas are highways now, and you're charging tolls on them. Big boss behavior, fr.
Guild Boss Energy
Found 10 Guildhalls and let them argue.
Ten guildhalls, each one sure it runs the city in secret. One of them is right, and it's chaotic.
Overseas Bag Network
Own 3 Ports and 5 Colonial Warehouses, the seas are yours.
Oceans of trade, and one warehouse full of things best not inventoried. Sus, but the books look immaculate.
Gold Bag Hoard
Bag up 1,000,000 gold, the bag is heavy.
Gold for days: one million, and you could swim in it if your advisors stopped fainting at the idea.
Shrine Starter
Set up your first Shrine and pray for the vibes.
Shrine unlocked, and the people now have an official spot to beg for better weather. Pray for the W.
Blessed Settlement Era
Line up 16 Shrines, it's a whole aesthetic.
Twenty-five shrines, and the priests are quietly fighting over foot traffic. Holy beef, honestly.
Holy City Hype
Spin up 18 Temples, faith is trending.
Twenty-five temples, a holy city, and parking so aggressive it's basically a sport.
Cathedral Core Era
Commission 10 Cathedrals, the architects are cooked.
Ten cathedrals, each one a whole generation of work. The architects left the grandkids a very detailed group project.
Crop Squad
Put 3 Gathering Camps down and play for ~1m, farm era.
No more wandering, you're farming now. Bold move, and we're all watching how it plays out.
Still Here Era
Stick around for ~14h 26m, unbothered.
Twenty-six thousand ticks survived, and whatever you're doing, it's apparently working. Do not change a thing.
Civ Never Dies
Stay locked in for ~3d, the commitment is real.
One hundred and thirty thousand ticks, and rival civs now study you in history class. Legendary, not a typo.
Time Skip Era
Pull up to the Classical Age and crack 10 techs.
Five ages and ten techs, and the time-travel vibes are frankly reckless. We stan the chaos.
Smoke Stack Boss
Hoard 10,000 coal and 5,000 iron ore, the mountain is ours.
Coal and ore piled high, and the sky is a color now. That color is 'industry.' Sus aesthetic, iconic results.
Lights On Era
Wire up 13 Coal Plants and 10 Steam Turbines, the grid cannot go down.
Lights never turn off now. Nobody is sure this is a W, but the night shift is thriving.
Bronze Glow Pioneer
Level up into the Bronze Age, big glow-up.
Mixing two soft metals makes a hard one. Revolutionary, slightly sus, and the bronze crowd is shook.
Iron Drip Era
Unlock the Iron Age, we're going hard.
Iron is harder, cheaper, and everywhere now. The bronze merchants are coping badly, respectfully.
Toga Party Scholar
Roll into the Classical Age, the lore is calling.
Philosophy, democracy, and columns everywhere. So many columns, it's giving aesthetic overload.
Knight Mode On
Dress up for the Medieval Age, it's giving knight.
Castles, knights, and a firm belief that bathing is a disease. Hygiene is not the vibe here.
Lit Renaissance
Hit the Renaissance Age, the glow-up is art.
Art and science are back, and everyone is painting people who never asked to be painted. Iconic, rude.
Colonial Flex
Make it to the Colonial Age, passport to chaos.
Distant lands discovered. The lands, for the record, were not lost, and they would like that noted.
Industrial Glow-Up
Power up to the Industrial Age, it's time to grind.
Machines do the work now, and the workers got promoted to babysitting them. Same pay, new title.
Victorian Plot Twist
Graduate to the Victorian Age, very proper, very sooty.
Progress, propriety, and a staggering amount of soot. The vibe is proper and absolutely filthy.
Electric Era Drop
Step into the Electric Age, lights on, no cap.
Lightning caught and stuffed in the walls. Zero downsides, surely, which is giving famous last words.
Atomic Hot Take
Get to the Atomic Age, we're splitting things.
You split the atom, and it is taking this so personally. Big yikes, no thoughts.
Modern Rizz Era
Touch down in the Modern Age, we made it.
Modern life is so convenient that nobody can find the time. Peak busy era.
Info Drop Pioneer
Log on to the Information Age, big data era.
All of humankind's knowledge in everyone's pocket, and they use it to argue in the comments. Mid.
Digital Glow Native
Boot up the Digital Age, the era is loaded.
Everything is digital now, problems included, and those are even harder to log off from. Main character glitch.
Jacked In Era
Jack into the Cyberpunk Age, neon is the vibe.
High tech, low life, neon everywhere, and even the rain has a sponsor. Peak cyberpunk, we love it.
Tiny Sun Pioneer
Ignite the Fusion Age, it's hot in here.
Tiny sun in a box, and the fire department has no notes, just fear. Literally living on the edge.
Space Side Quest
Blast off to the Space Age, bye Earth.
You left the planet and the planet is honestly relieved to get some space. Real ones understand.
Star Hopper Era
Warp to the Interstellar Age, the commute is wild.
Other stars now, and the commute is appalling. The views though, unmatched.
Galaxy Brain Emperor
Conquer the Galactic Age, galaxy-brain move.
An empire across the galaxy, and the paperwork arrives at light speed, which is still too slow. Bureaucracy has no chill.
Quantum Glow Master
Phase into the Quantum Age, both here and not here.
Quantum level now, where your civ exists and doesn't until somebody looks at it. Touch grass, observer.
Beyond the Matrix
Ascend into the Transcendent Age, you're past the bare minimum.
Matter, time, and need, all transcended. You still, somehow, refresh the production graph.
